description: This file defines types, constants, and functions related to authentication health status, including profile and provider health assessments, status resolution, and summary generation for an authentication system.

methods.name: resolveAuthProfileSource
methods.description: Returns the source of an authentication profile, currently fixed to 'store'.

methods.name: formatRemainingShort
methods.description: Formats remaining milliseconds into a short human-readable string, e.g., '1m', '2h', '3d'.

methods.name: resolveOAuthStatus
methods.description: Determines OAuth token status based on expiry time, current time, and warning threshold.

methods.name: buildProfileHealth
methods.description: Constructs an AuthProfileHealth object based on credential data, status evaluation, and labels.

methods.name: buildAuthHealthSummary
methods.description: Generates a summary of authentication health for profiles and providers, with optional filtering.
